account: The International Telecommunication Union entry names Christ University, Bangalore, as the developer. The code repository that the entry names holds one commit, made on 17 April 2025, with one empty file. In the entry, current as of June 2025, the team describes a minimum viable product in development that uses proposed modeling and vulnerability assessment to inform heat mitigation. The intended beneficiaries include people exposed to extreme heat and city planners. Wider climate-risk integration is planned. No source reports an implemented cooling action, a measured temperature change or a health outcome.
